claims: St. John's University is a private Roman Catholic, Vincentian institution.
St. John's University was founded in 1870.
St. John's University is based in Queens, NYC.
St. John's University is known as the Red Storm.
St. John's University has an ~83% acceptance rate.
St. John's University has a 3.5 GPA average.
St. John's University men's basketball is under coach Rick Pitino.
St. John's University (NY) has a main campus in Queens.
St. John's University (NY) has additional NY locations in Staten Island and Manhattan.
St. John's University (NY) has international locations in Rome, Paris, and Seville.
St. John's University has a 2024 acceptance rate of 83.43%.
Admitted students to St. John's University typically have a GPA of around 3.5.
Half of the admitted applicants to St. John's University submit SAT scores between 1150 and 1340.
Half of the admitted applicants to St. John's University submit ACT scores between 24 and 29.
St. John's University competes in NCAA Division I.
St. John's University competes as part of the Big East Conference.
St. John's University is famously known for its basketball team.
